running_thesis: The Nasdaq-100 fell 2.67% on 16 Nov (S&P 500 -1.92%) on Nvidia-led AI selling, while yields eased (10-year 5.12%). VIX 22.91, VXN 32.9, COR1M 16.42 (+39.15%). Polymarket has a 25 bps December hike at 91.5% and 50+ bps at 5.1%. Nvidia reports after the close Tue 17 Nov with an 8% to 8.5% implied move, the first call since the CEO resigned. Retail sales Tue 14:30 CET and FOMC minutes Wed 20:00 CET follow. Credit has not shown stress as of 13 Nov (HY OAS 3.23). Oil data are stale.
open_questions: Does Nvidia's guidance or succession commentary stop or extend the AI selloff?
Does the retail sales print or the minutes shift the December hike odds?
Does rising COR1M signal broader contagion beyond tech?
Is the 5 Nov Nasdaq-100 drop of 6.36% fully digested?

themes.Fed hikes and rising yields: continuing, but yields eased on 16 Nov; 25 bps December hike at 91.5% on Polymarket
themes.Oil retreat: fading, official data stale to 11 Nov
themes.Implied correlation (COR1M 11.8): jumped on 13 Nov from a low level, still far below 6 Nov
themes.NVDA leadership change and earnings: strengthening, price and options evidence on 16 Nov
themes.AI trade test (Nvidia earnings, Anthropi: active, earnings after the close Tue 17 Nov
